title: Assert deterministic transport work in the slim HTTPS evidence workflow
outcome: The mismatch workflow regression test fails if the reduced fetch and confined-launch counts grow again, without using wall-clock pass/fail.
acceptance: The HTTPS evidence-mismatch test asserts deterministic request or confined-launch counts against a same-run single-request baseline; elapsed-time values remain diagnostic only, and the Central timeout root cause stays explicitly unclaimed until a Windows phase log identifies it.
